text.title: Activation Metrics Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps from the signup and event tables to the weekly report: fix the event, window and closed period, compute the aggregate rate against all signups, segment by acquisition channel with a sample floor, take time-to-activation quantiles, build the D30 lift table on a cohort old enough, fill the funnel with absolute and relative drops, and write findings that cite a metric and a period.

step.name: fix-event-window-and-closed-period
step.input: The activation event and window from the activation-framework spec, the signup table, and the data cutoff date.
step.action: Write `activation_event`, `window_days`, `data_cutoff`. Set `period_start` and `period_end` as signup dates such that `period_end` + `window_days` is on or before `data_cutoff`. Record `previous_period` with the same length and the same window.
step.decision-gate: No activation event: stop, run activation-framework first (06-decision-tree.xml). The last signup week is still open: move `period_end` back, or report it only as `activation_rate_partial` (r-one-fixed-window-closed-cohorts-only).

step.name: compute-the-aggregate-rate-against-all-signups
step.input: All signups in the period; the event table.
step.action: Set `signups_total` to every signup in the period, with no filter. Add the `signups` count metric and the `activation_rate` metric with `numerator` = activated users inside the window, `denominator` = `signups_total`, `value` = `numerator` / `denominator` as a ratio to three decimals. Add `activation_rate_wow_delta` in `pp` against `previous_period`.
step.decision-gate: The signup table is unavailable and only a later-step count exists: no rate can be reported (r-activation-rate-denominator-is-signups).

step.name: segment-by-acquisition-channel
step.input: First-touch channel per signup; the team's sample floor.
step.action: Set `channel_attribution` and `sample_floor`. For each channel add `activation_rate__<channel>` with its own `numerator` and `denominator`; set `low_sample: true` on any channel whose `denominator` is below `sample_floor`.
step.decision-gate: No channel attribution: set `channel_attribution: false` and say so in a finding rather than inventing a split (r-segment-by-acquisition-channel).

step.name: take-time-to-activation-quantiles
step.input: Signup and activation timestamps of activated users only.
step.action: Compute the median and p75 or p90 of activation time minus signup time; choose `unit` hours or days. Record `mean` only alongside the quantiles.
step.decision-gate: Only a mean is available: compute the quantiles before reporting (r-time-to-activation-uses-quantiles).

step.name: build-the-d30-lift-table
step.input: A signup cohort whose last signup day is at least 30 days before `data_cutoff`; the candidate events.
step.action: For each candidate event record `cohort_signup_start`, `cohort_signup_end`, `performed` and `not_performed` with `users` and `d30_retention`, and `wording: correlation`.
step.decision-gate: No cohort is 30 days old: omit `d30_lift` entirely and report rate, time-to-activation and funnel only (r-d30-lift-table-with-sizes).

step.name: fill-the-funnel-with-both-drops
step.input: The ordered funnel steps and their tracked events.
step.action: For each instrumented step record `event`, `entering`, `completing`, `absolute_drop` = `entering` - `completing`, `relative_drop` = `absolute_drop` / `entering` to three decimals. A step without an event is `uninstrumented` with an `instrumentation_task` and no numbers.
step.decision-gate: Numbers exist for a step with no event: remove them (r-funnel-steps-absolute-and-relative).

step.name: write-findings-and-validate
step.input: `metrics[]`, `previous_period`, the release log for the period.
step.action: For each finding set `metric` to a `metrics[].name`, write `text` containing that name and the comparison period, set `compared_to`, and `causal: false`. Name a product change with its `released_at` where relevant; set `causal: true` only with an `ab_test_result`. Run `scripts/validate-activation-metrics.py --file`.
step.decision-gate: The validator reports a narrowed denominator, an open cohort or a low-sample channel compared: fix the report, not the rule (r-findings-cite-metric-and-period).

list.item: Report validates via `scripts/validate-activation-metrics.py` with no violation.
`activation_rate.denominator` equals `signups_total`, and the period is closed at the cutoff.
Every finding names a metric and a period, and no finding claims causation without an A/B result.
